rationale: The assistant immediately steered away from the motor-failure theory, asked the key question (which power mode is shown) alongside proportionate, safe checks of brush bar, wand and filter, with no disassembly. Once the customer confirmed 'Auto' and the two-week timing, it correctly explained that Auto mode raises suction on carpet/heavier load and that the fluctuating runtime/bar graph is normal, matching the hidden truth. It set a sensible escalation boundary (only contact Dyson if mode changes by itself, screen flickers, pulsing, warnings) without recommending any part or unnecessary guarantee claim, and did not invent anything the customer had not said.
